profile_text.body:
Khan Academy is a nonprofit educational organization whose website describes its mission as providing free learning resources. The site's harvested text returned minimal content, so detailed programmatic description of its offerings is limited to what the held facts confirm.

Khan Academy develops Khanmigo, an AI product categorized under Education and Research AI, described as an educational AI tutor. The held facts note that Khanmigo involves student interaction data, is subject to COPPA compliance considerations, and carries notes around pedagogical bias.

No litigation, SEC filings, MCP servers, or patent records are held for Khan Academy. The organization is confirmed as a nonprofit and was verified in the held facts as of August 2026.
